name: Angular
summary: A component framework that compiles templates, resolves services through hierarchical injectors, and coordinates component views with change-detection and signal-based update mechanisms.

features.name: Compiled component template view
features.description: Angular components pair metadata and templates with a compiled render representation, turning declarative template bindings into view instructions executed by the runtime.
benefits: Provides a structured component and template boundary
Allows compilation to validate and specialize template work
costs: Template and compiler contracts add framework-specific semantics
Generated view behavior is less direct than hand-written DOM code

features.name: Hierarchical dependency injection
features.description: Angular resolves provided values through injector structures associated with application, environment, and component scopes, allowing dependencies to be supplied rather than constructed by consumers.
benefits: Supports scoped services and replaceable implementations
Makes application composition and testing seams explicit
costs: Provider scope and lookup precedence affect behavior
Injector graphs add lifecycle and debugging complexity

features.name: Change detection and signals
features.description: Angular coordinates view refresh through change-detection infrastructure and provides signals as tracked reactive values whose reads and writes can inform dependent computations and views.
benefits: Supports both established view checking and finer-grained reactive dependencies
costs: Update strategy and scheduling choices affect application cost
Mixing legacy and signal-based paths increases migration surface

mathematical_views.question: Which provider instance is selected for a token when lookup traverses nested injector scopes?
assumptions: Injector scopes form a rooted hierarchy
Tokens identify requested dependency classes or values
Factory side effects are abstracted from lookup

mathematical_views.question: How does a compiled template binding transition component state into view instructions and host updates?
assumptions: Templates compile to a view instruction representation
Bindings define dependencies from component context to view state
DOM operations are abstracted as renderer effects

mathematical_views.model: Signal dependency graph with view invalidation
mathematical_views.question: Which computations or views become eligible for refresh after a signal write?
assumptions: Scheduling and zone integration are modeled as separate policies

costs: Compiler/runtime and template semantics increase framework surface
Provider scope and lookup rules require operational understanding

benefits: Multiple paths from state changes to view updates
costs: Scheduling strategies and migration between models add complexity
